{
  "test_name": "LedgerIssueClosedGenericValueTypeReferencedAssembly",
  "test_code": "using System;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class LedgerIssueClosedGenericValueTypeReferencedAssembly\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task DoesNotCrashAndGeneratesResolver()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace Lib;\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic partial record struct Item<T>([property: Key(0)] string Key);\n\"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\nusing Lib;\n\nnamespace App;\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n{\n    [Key(1)] public Item<int> Member { get; init; }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        var messagePackRefs = ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack);\n        var frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        var baseRefs = messagePackRefs.Concat(frameworkRefs).ToImmutableArray();\n\n        // Compile the referenced library assembly\n        var libTree = CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(libSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest));\n        var libCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"Lib\",\n            new[] { libTree },\n            baseRefs,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        using var libStream = new MemoryStream();\n        var libEmit = libCompilation.Emit(libStream);\n        Assert.True(libEmit.Success, string.Join(\"\\n\", libEmit.Diagnostics.Select(d => d.ToString())));\n        libStream.Position = 0;\n        var libRef = MetadataReference.CreateFromStream(libStream);\n\n        // Compile the consuming assembly with the generator\n        var appTree = CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest));\n        var appRefs = baseRefs.Add(libRef);\n        var appCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { appTree },\n            appRefs,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        // Run the source generator\n        var driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out var outputCompilation, out var generatorDiagnostics);\n        var runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        // Generator must not throw IndexOutOfRangeException (CS8785)\n        foreach (var result in runResult.Results)\n        {\n            Assert.Null(result.Exception, $\"Generator threw: {result.Exception}\");\n        }\n\n        // Run the analyzer\n        var analyzerDiagnostics = await outputCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        // Analyzer must not crash (AD0001)\n        foreach (var diag in analyzerDiagnostics)\n        {\n            Assert.NotEqual(\"AD0001\", diag.Id, $\"Analyzer crashed: {diag}\");\n        }\n\n        // A resolver must be generated\n        var resolverHint = runResult.Results\n            .SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources)\n            .FirstOrDefault(s => s.HintName.Contains(\"Resolver\", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverHint);\n    }\n}"
}
